'''Marewin''' is a noblewoman at King [[Ailron]]'s court in [[Amadicia]]. She is slight and little more than a girl.

==Activities==

Marewin was set to serve [[Morgase]] during her stay in [[Amador]] as one of her ladies-in-waiting. She looks as if she might faint when hearing news of [[Rand]].
